test_prompt: Explain the concept of machine learning in simple terms.

ablation_config._comment: Android ablation studies now supported via AndroidAblationEngine!
ablation_config._implementation: Uses native llama.cpp --prompt-cache flag for disk caching tests

_CRITICAL_LIMITATION.what_it_measures: Incremental benefit of adding disk cache ON TOP OF always-active RAM KV cache
what_it_does_NOT_measure: Pure RAM cache effect (no true 'no cache' baseline exists)
RAM vs Disk comparison (both active simultaneously in cold/warm runs)
True overhead of each cache type independently

test_scenarios.control: KV cache only (RAM, always active) - NOT a true 'no cache' baseline
test_scenarios.cold: KV cache (RAM) + Prompt cache (Disk, creating file)
test_scenarios.warm: KV cache (RAM) + Prompt cache (Disk, loaded from file)

_CRITICAL_LIMITATION.why: llama-cli CANNOT disable KV cache - it's always active in RAM
_CRITICAL_LIMITATION.workaround: Use llama-server with --cache-ram 0 for true cache control

_IMPORTANT_CACHE_CONTROL.limitation: llama-cli CANNOT disable KV cache (always active in RAM)
_IMPORTANT_CACHE_CONTROL.workaround_2: Use llama-cpp-python on supported platforms (can set cache=False)
_IMPORTANT_CACHE_CONTROL.impact: Control runs will have KV cache active, not a true 'no cache' baseline
_IMPORTANT_CACHE_CONTROL.recommendation: For accurate ablation studies, use llama-server instead of llama-cli

_llama_server_example.note: cache_prompt must be false in API requests, defaults to true if omitted

_interpretation_guide.control_vs_cold: Shows overhead of CREATING disk cache (may be slower due to I/O)
_interpretation_guide.control_vs_warm: Shows benefit of ADDING disk cache to existing RAM cache
_interpretation_guide.cold_vs_warm: Shows benefit of LOADING vs CREATING disk cache
_interpretation_guide.note: All comparisons have RAM KV cache active in both scenarios

ablation_config._note_advanced: If you need more advanced caching tests:
ablation_config._option2: KV cache (RAM) is always active but cannot be controlled
ablation_config._option3: For full cache control, use llama-server or llama-cpp-python on supported platforms

supported_features: Throughput measurement (TTFT, prefill TPS, decode TPS)
unsupported_features: KV cache control (always enabled, cannot be disabled)
RAM vs disk cache comparison (KV cache is always RAM)
Concurrent caching tests (not yet implemented for Android)
recommendations: Use smaller quantizations (Q2_K, Q4_0) for limited RAM
Reduce context_size to 512 or 1024 if memory is tight
Enable batch_size_tests to find optimal batch size for your device
Use lower visualization_dpi (150) to save storage space

expected_tests: Quantization profiling: Q8_0, Q4_0, Q2_K (3 iterations each)
Prompt cache ablation studies: control, cold cache, warm cache
